items.item_text: California Driver's License in good standing (subject to DMV Pull).
Experience in utilizing heavy duty transport carts, furniture dollies, supply dollies, cargo van, box truck, electric pallet jack, manual pallet jack, and forklift.

As a Lead Central Service Technician, you will provide general direction and training to staff to ensure that production is maintained in all areas and assigned tasks are completed at the UCLA Distribution Center. You will be responsible for verifying adequate materials and equipment are supplied throughout the Health System and ensuring the clinical departments' needs are met. This position is required to deliver supplies to UCLA Health sites by driving university vehicles.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Allocate tasks and assign routes to staff for operations
Recommend inventory cost reduction initiatives, assist in establishing operating standards, and helps implement quality improvements
Perform data entry, manage inventory, maintain PAR levels and back up supplies
Order, receive, distribute, and deliver supplies in a timely manner
Work closely with the clinical staff to identify their needs
Work on back-order reports and coordinate product substitute with Procurement and vendors
Processing order for inventory picking
Maintaining of equipment such as mobile devices, vehicle and so on to be in good used condition.
Highly motivated self-starter and comfortable in a fast-paced environment; thrive in a team environment and confident to share their ideas for efficiencies and improvement.
Ability to operate a University vehicle to deliver supplies to multiple off-site locations.
Demonstrated basic knowledge of materials management information system and other vendor software.
Ability to understand and adhere to the healthcare regulations for infection control.
Ability to demonstrate a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Demonstrate the ability to perform basic mathematical calculations.
Ability to understand and adhere to Materials Management and UCLA Policies and procedures.
Demonstrated communications skills, ability to maintain good guest relations interdepartmentally, intra-departmentally, using English language in both written and verbal format.
Skills for accurate calculations of inventory replenishment, weight, units of measure, and package counts
Ability to lift up to 50lbs, and push/pull up to 400 lbs.
